schema.name: ask_thread
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ask_thread (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

)

schema.name: audit_log
schema.sql:

    event TEXT NOT NULL,

    detail TEXT NOT NULL,
    prev_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
)

schema.name: idempotency_ledger
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE idempotency_ledger (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'completed', 'failed')),
    result TEXT,
    error TEXT,
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT
)

schema.name: intent
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE intent (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    meeting_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meeting(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    sealed_intent BLOB NOT NULL,
    resolution BLOB,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, deleted_at TEXT, seen_at TEXT)

schema.name: intent_event
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE intent_event (
    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    intent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intent(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    from_status TEXT,
    to_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail TEXT,
    at TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: manual_action
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE manual_action (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    meeting_id TEXT REFERENCES meeting(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    sealed_action BLOB NOT NULL,
    resolution BLOB,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    deleted_at TEXT
, seen_at TEXT)

schema.name: meeting
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "meeting" (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    bundle_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    phone_device_id TEXT REFERENCES paired_device(device_id),
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_seconds REAL NOT NULL,
    received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    attestation_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    attestation_latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sealed_record BLOB NOT NULL,
    origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'phone' CHECK (origin IN ('phone', 'computer')),
    CHECK ((origin = 'phone') = (phone_device_id IS NOT NULL))
)

schema.name: meeting_audio
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE meeting_audio (
    meeting_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meeting(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    idx INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    purged_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (meeting_id, idx)
)

schema.name: outbox
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE outbox (
    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivered_at TEXT
)

schema.name: paired_device
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE paired_device (
    device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    signing_key BLOB NOT NULL,
    agreement_key BLOB NOT NULL,
    transport_psk BLOB NOT NULL,
    paired_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    revoked_at TEXT
)

schema.name: setting
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE setting (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

schema.name: audit_append_only_delete
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER audit_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_log
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit_log is append-only'); END

schema.name: audit_append_only_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER audit_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_log
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit_log is append-only'); END

schema.name: intent_event_append_only_delete
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER intent_event_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON intent_event
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intent WHERE id = OLD.intent_id) > 0
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'intent_event is append-only'); END

schema.name: intent_event_append_only_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER intent_event_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON intent_event
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'intent_event is append-only'); END
